Experimental_Design.Conditions: matching, nonmatching (individual associations: self, friend, high reward, low reward; conditions 1 & 2 pairing self with high/low reward)

Block_Structure.Practice_trials: 3 practice blocks of 8 trials (first block with 1000 ms stimulus + instructions, second with 500 ms, third at real speed)
Block_Structure.Trial_number: 48 trials per run (16 per block; 6 trials per shape-label association); data include two runs (PMT1 + PMT2) = 96 trials per participant

Trial_Structure.ITI: Blank screen until response or 1500 ms elapsed
Trial_Structure.Feedback_duration: 500 ms (correct, incorrect, too slow; after each trial)

Stimulus_Properties.Shape: Geometric shapes (octagon, rhomboid, diamond, triangle, pentagon, trapeze, kite, square)
Stimulus_Properties.Label: English words: you, friend, high reward, low reward

exp2.detail: Procedure identical to Experiment 1 except happy/neutral labels replaced by reward values (high reward = 9, low reward = 1). Database contains only the shape-label matching task data (PMT1 + PMT2 runs, 96 trials per participant, 51 participants). Source: paper main text + Supplementary Material.
